stageOrCutPoint: fresh initialization completes every file and directory barrier
artifactImage: C=1, empty journal, W=(1,1)
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Only the exact initialization artifacts and their durability state may change.

stageOrCutPoint: initialization stops before durable publication of C=1
artifactImage: one or more pre-marker reserved artifacts without a durable v2 commit marker
unchangedArtifactAssertion: The v2 writer does not adopt, repair, or complete a pre-marker partial directory.

stageOrCutPoint: C=1 is durable and the empty journal is exact, but the witness is absent
artifactImage: C=1, empty journal, no workflow.publish.json
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Only the exclusive writer may create and barrier W=(1,0), revalidate it, and then write CLEAN.

stageOrCutPoint: exclusive reopen of exact W=(1,0) completes the mandatory rebarrier
artifactImage: C=1, empty journal, exact W=(1,0), then W=(1,1)
profileObservation: same opened mount and artifact identities before CLEAN
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Commit and journal remain byte-for-byte unchanged while only the witness becomes CLEAN.

stageOrCutPoint: W=(1,0) file sync succeeds, state-directory sync fails, and a same-boot reopen sees the file
artifactImage: C=1, empty journal, visible W=(1,0) with unproven namespace durability
profileObservation: supported profile remains visible but past directory durability is not inferred
unchangedArtifactAssertion: CLEAN is forbidden until a new witness sync, directory sync, and identity/content revalidation succeed.

stageOrCutPoint: witness path identity changes between rebarrier and CLEAN
artifactImage: C=1, empty journal, replaced W=(1,0) path or inode
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No CLEAN write, journal append, commit rewrite, repair, or replacement is permitted.

stageOrCutPoint: final W=(1,1) becomes visible after all prerequisite barriers but its own sync reports failure
artifactImage: C=1, empty journal, visible exact W=(1,1)
profileObservation: all prerequisite profile and artifact checks passed
unchangedArtifactAssertion: The triggering operation stops; a later reader may use the fully revalidated CLEAN image.

stageOrCutPoint: reader observes CLEAN witness without the required commit marker
artifactImage: empty journal, W=(1,1), missing workflow.commit.json
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Reader and writer leave every visible artifact unchanged.

stageOrCutPoint: initialization image contains journal bytes
artifactImage: C=1, W=(1,0), non-empty journal
unchangedArtifactAssertion: The non-empty image is not adopted, truncated, promoted, or cleaned.

stageOrCutPoint: version probe sees the historical v1 commit document
artifactImage: storeVersion=1 commit with no v2 witness
unchangedArtifactAssertion: The v1 state is never overwritten, adopted, or migrated.

stageOrCutPoint: version probe sees an unsupported store version
artifactImage: well-formed commit envelope with an unsupported storeVersion
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No reserved artifact changes.

stageOrCutPoint: witness decode or closed-shape validation fails
artifactImage: C=1, empty journal, malformed or contradictory workflow.publish.json
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Malformed bytes are not repaired or replaced.

stageOrCutPoint: reader or writer opens a completely revalidated clean generation G
artifactImage: W=(G,G), C=G, exact journal generation G
profileObservation: supported profile and all artifact identities match
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No mutation occurs until the writer begins the next PREPARED transition.

stageOrCutPoint: durable PREPARED precedes the first journal byte
artifactImage: W=(G+1,G), C=G, exact old journal G
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Reopen performs no rollback, CLEAN rewrite, append, or repair.

stageOrCutPoint: journal write started but the next record is partial
artifactImage: W=(G+1,G), C=G, old prefix plus partial bytes
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Partial bytes are not truncated or promoted.

stageOrCutPoint: journal barrier completed before commit publication
artifactImage: W=(G+1,G), C=G, exact journal generation G+1
unchangedArtifactAssertion: The complete unpublished record is neither promoted nor retried.

stageOrCutPoint: new commit namespace is durable but CLEAN has not been released
artifactImage: W=(G+1,G), C=G+1, exact journal generation G+1
unchangedArtifactAssertion: A reader never completes the release transition.

stageOrCutPoint: clean metadata names a shorter prefix than the physical journal
artifactImage: W=(G,G), C=G, valid prefix plus extra tail bytes
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Tail bytes are not truncated, decoded as committed, or promoted.

stageOrCutPoint: clean generation digest verification fails
artifactImage: W=(G,G), C=G, journal length/count match but SHA-256 differs
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Corrupt journal and metadata remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

stageOrCutPoint: metadata generations are neither clean nor one prepared successor
artifactImage: startedGeneration is more than publishedGeneration+1 or commit generation is gapped
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Impossible ordering is not repaired.

stageOrCutPoint: publishedGeneration exceeds startedGeneration
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Reverse witness values are not normalized.

stageOrCutPoint: append requested at the clean maximum generation
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Journal, commit, witness, and all metadata remain unchanged.

stageOrCutPoint: CLEAN G+1 is visible after durable journal and commit namespace, but its own sync fails
artifactImage: W=(G+1,G+1), C=G+1, exact journal generation G+1
profileObservation: all prerequisite barriers and checks succeeded
unchangedArtifactAssertion: The failed operation performs no further write or retry.

stageOrCutPoint: opened-directory profile qualification
artifactImage: clean or fresh supported state
profileObservation: x86_64 GNU/Linux, returned MNT_ID, one ext4 mountinfo row, rw, matching device, ext magic
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Profile inspection alone does not mutate the state directory.

stageOrCutPoint: statfs magic matches the ext family but mountinfo fs_type is not ext4
artifactImage: otherwise valid state
profileObservation: shared 0xEF53 magic with non-ext4 authority record
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Magic-only fallback is forbidden and no state mutation occurs.

stageOrCutPoint: statx result lacks the requested MNT_ID mask bit
artifactImage: otherwise valid state
profileObservation: returned statx mask does not contain MNT_ID
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No lexical-path or filesystem-magic substitute is used.

stageOrCutPoint: mount ID resolves to zero or multiple usable mountinfo records
artifactImage: otherwise valid state
profileObservation: missing, unreadable, malformed, or ambiguous mountinfo binding
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No state artifact is created or changed.

stageOrCutPoint: mountinfo per-mount options reject read-write qualification
artifactImage: otherwise valid state
profileObservation: per-mount options omit rw or contain ro
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No state mutation occurs on a read-only mount observation.

stageOrCutPoint: mountinfo superblock options contain ro
artifactImage: otherwise valid state
profileObservation: superblock options after the separator contain ro
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No state mutation occurs.

stageOrCutPoint: fresh directory qualification differs from its previously qualified parent
artifactImage: new directory exists but contains no published initialization
profileObservation: parent and child mount ID or device differ
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No lock, journal, commit, or witness is created on the mismatched child.

stageOrCutPoint: reserved artifact device or mount ID differs from the opened state directory
artifactImage: otherwise valid metadata and journal
profileObservation: artifact device or mount binding mismatch
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No artifact is repaired or replaced.

stageOrCutPoint: path no longer names the opened and validated artifact identity
artifactImage: reserved path replaced during qualification
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No write follows a failed identity revalidation.

stageOrCutPoint: reader authority check occurs on an unsupported profile
artifactImage: metadata may appear clean but profile qualification fails
profileObservation: any unsupported target, filesystem, mount, or device observation
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Reader remains read-only and never returns a known disposition.

stageOrCutPoint: fd-bound statx call reports NOSYS
artifactImage: otherwise valid state
profileObservation: safe rustix statx unavailable from the running kernel/container
unchangedArtifactAssertion: No fallback or state mutation is permitted.

stageOrCutPoint: journal bytes change between two appends on one writer instance
artifactImage: previously clean metadata with externally changed committed prefix
profileObservation: supported profile and unchanged path identities
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Second append changes no journal, commit, witness, or temporary artifact.

stageOrCutPoint: commit document changes between two appends on one writer instance
artifactImage: externally changed commit bytes or generation
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Second append leaves all artifacts byte-for-byte unchanged.

stageOrCutPoint: publication witness changes between two appends on one writer instance
artifactImage: externally changed witness bytes or generation relation
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Second append performs no PREPARED rewrite or other mutation.

stageOrCutPoint: a reserved artifact path is replaced between two appends
artifactImage: bytes may be internally consistent but identity no longer matches
profileObservation: artifact identity, device, mount, owner, mode, type, or link check fails
unchangedArtifactAssertion: Second append changes no artifact after failed revalidation.
